summary: Trump declares Iran's final chance to sign a nuclear deal while revealing a planned massive attack was halted; Iran's senior advisor claims the US violated a Hormuz MoU and inflicted severe blows, vowing to target unauthorized warships. IDF eliminates a senior PIJ commander involved in the October 7 attacks and hostage ceremonies. Defense Minister Katz retracts a televised announcement to replace Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth after IDF pushback.
key_points: Trump states Iran has a last chance to sign an agreement, reveals a planned attack larger than any since WWII was stopped at Iran's request. (Source: @inon_yttach/9802, @naya_foriraq/86838)
Iranian advisor Mohsen Rezaei claims US violated the Hormuz MoU, Iran dealt severe blows in 17 days of fighting, and will target unauthorized warships. (Source: @presstv/201451)

IDF eliminates PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair in Deir al-Balah; he infiltrated on Oct 7, held Rom Braslavski captive, appeared in hostage release ceremonies. (Source: @almogboker78/17884, @yediotnews25/133543)
Hamas affirms commitment to the ceasefire second phase, awaits official response from mediator Nikolay Mladenov. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382731)

Defense Minister Katz retracts announcement to replace Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth; IDF Chief of Staff expresses full trust in Bluth. (Source: @manniefabian/58916, @yediotnews25/133551, @inon_yttach/9792)
Satellite imagery shows damage to Yanbu facilities in Saudi Arabia from recent Houthi attacks. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86840)
Iran executes two citizens convicted of spying for Israel, including providing intelligence on military sites. (Source: @asafroz/52210, @VahidOnline/77712)
Italy allocates 10 million euros to support the Palestinian Authority budget. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94044)

sections.executive_summary: Trump declares Iran's final chance to sign a nuclear deal while revealing a planned massive attack was halted; Iran's senior advisor claims the US violated a Hormuz MoU and inflicted severe blows, vowing to target unauthorized warships. IDF eliminates a senior PIJ commander involved in the October 7 attacks and hostage ceremonies. Defense Minister Katz retracts a televised announcement to replace Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth after IDF pushback.

points: Senior advisor Mohsen Rezaei states the US accepted Iran's Hormuz arrangements under the Islamabad MoU but later violated it, launching attacks without referring disputes to the designated panel; Iran inflicted severe blows during 17 days of fighting and possesses missiles to defend itself, warning it will target any unauthorized warships in the Strait and will not permit a second corridor. (Source: @presstv/201451, @presstv/201467)

Rezaei reveals Iran planned to strike three sites in Ukraine but canceled after Ukraine apologized; Iran's armed forces are fully prepared to defend the country to the last drop of blood. (Source: @presstv/201451)

Seyed Mohammad Marandi, close to the Iranian negotiating team, declares Iran does not intend to negotiate with the Trump administration and any hostile act will be met with a crushing, decisive response. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382742)
Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Ismail Baghaei confirms no negotiations are underway between Iran and the US; current talks are bilateral between Iran and Oman. (Source: @VahidOnline/77716)

Iran's judiciary executes two citizens, Omid Behzad and Pouria Safwat, for espionage and intelligence cooperation with Israel via sending images of security and military centers; confessions were reportedly obtained under unclear conditions. (Source: @VahidOnline/77712, @asafroz/52210)
Footage released from exercises of the 82nd Airborne Division paratroopers indicates a serious ground attack capability. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/78638)

Defense Minister Israel Katz announces on live television the replacement of Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth, who has served since July 2024, but retracts the statement hours later, saying Bluth performs well and there is no dispute. (Source: @manniefabian/58916, @yediotnews25/133551)

IDF Chief of Staff states Bluth commands Central Command in a complex reality with professionalism, courage, and sacrifice, enjoying full trust; no intention to replace key commanders during this sensitive period. (Source: @inon_yttach/9792)

IDF eliminates PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair in a strike in Deir al-Balah; he infiltrated Israel on October 7, participated in holding Rom Braslavski captive, appeared in PIJ uniform at six hostage release ceremonies (including Ofir Engel, Amit Shani, Moran Stella Yanai, Itay Regev, Liam Or Natzar, Raz Ben Ami, and others), and recently promoted terror plans against IDF and civilians. (Source: @almogboker78/17884, @yediotnews25/133543)

Military prosecution indicts Nour Shams Battalion chief Kamal Khatib for the July 1, 2024 IED attack that killed Staff Sgt. (res.) Yehuda Gato; the IED was remotely detonated via cell phone from a room in Balaa neighborhood, overturning a security forces vehicle; additional charges include heading an unauthorized association, arms dealing, and planting bombs. (Source: @idf_telegram/24814)

Reserve battalion 'Agud Shabahut' operates as a critical air-land connector, airlifting entire battalions into battle, evacuating wounded under fire, and managing joint operations across arms. (Source: @idf_telegram/24816)

Hamas source states the movement and Palestinian factions adhere to the agreed second phase of the ceasefire, including all parties' commitments, and await a clear official response from mediator Nikolay Mladenov and the brother mediators. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382731)

Peace Council emphasizes after Mladenov's meeting with Netanyahu that full IDF withdrawal beyond the yellow line will occur only after completion of dismantlement of light weapons, heavy weapons, and tunnels, as Hamas committed to mediators; implementation to be monitored by an international stabilization force and a verification committee including the US and Peace Council; Israel opposes any withdrawal before dismantlement. (Source: @almogboker78/17887)
Italy allocates 10 million euros to support the Palestinian Authority budget. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94044)
IDF Southern Command forces remain deployed in Gaza per the agreement and continue acting to remove threats. (Source: @yediotnews25/133543)
Indictment filed against Nour Shams Battalion chief for a West Bank attack in July 2024 killing an Israeli soldier. (Source: @idf_telegram/24814)
Monitoring reports two transport helicopters heading north toward occupied Palestine (South Lebanon) an hour ago. (Source: @redlinkleb/34593)
Warplanes flying in the south at maximum alert. (Source: @redlinkleb/34596)
Public urged to report any hostile activity (drones, warplanes) via new or old bots to strengthen the internal front. (Source: @redlinkleb/34575)
A large explosion shakes the Al-Sharqiya neighborhood in Hama city, Syria; causes remain unknown. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382739)
Iranian advisor Mohsen Rezaei states Iran planned to strike three sites in Ukraine but canceled the attack following Ukraine's apology. (Source: @presstv/201451)
Satellite images show damage to facilities and refineries in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia, from recent Houthi attacks launched from Yemen. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86840)

Trump claims the US has full naval control of the Strait of Hormuz, Iran cannot impose tariffs, and oil prices will drop significantly when business with Iran concludes; he vows not to allow Iran to impose tariffs against anyone. (Source: @SharghDaily/176083)

Mohsen Rezaei warns if the blockade continues, American vessels and forces will face serious risks and casualties; the US must change behavior or Iran will not tolerate it, and will never permit a second corridor in the Strait. (Source: @presstv/201467)

(Source: @inon_yttach/9802, @naya_foriraq/86838, @mamlekate/104066)

IDF eliminates PIJ Nukhba commander Mahmoud Fatair in a Deir al-Balah strike; he infiltrated on October 7, held Rom Braslavski captive, and appeared in six hostage release ceremonies. (Source: @almogboker78/17884, @yediotnews25/133543)

Hamas affirms commitment to the ceasefire second phase and awaits official response from mediator Nikolay Mladenov; Israel insists on full dismantlement before any withdrawal. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/382731, @almogboker78/17887)

Defense Minister Katz publicly announces then retracts replacement of Central Command chief Maj. Gen. Avi Bluth; IDF Chief of Staff affirms full trust in Bluth and no intention to replace key commanders. (Source: @manniefabian/58916, @yediotnews25/133551, @inon_yttach/9792)

Satellite imagery confirms damage to Yanbu facilities in Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks; Iran denies negotiation with Trump and warns of a crushing response to any hostility. (Source: @naya_foriraq/86840, @rasedal3ado138e/382742)

Iran executes two citizens for alleged espionage for Israel; Iranian FM states no Iran-US talks are occurring, only bilateral Iran-Oman discussions. (Source: @asafroz/52210, @VahidOnline/77712, @VahidOnline/77716)
sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of Trump's 'last chance' ultimatum to Iran, Iran's declared readiness to target unauthorized shipping in Hormuz, and the IDF's targeted killing of a senior PIJ operative involved in October 7 creates a multi-axis escalation risk. Iran's claim of having inflicted severe blows on US forces in the Strait suggests a lowered threshold for direct confrontation. The public discord between Israel's political and military leadership over command appointments adds internal friction during a period of high operational tempo in Gaza and the West Bank. Houthi strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure demonstrate the regional reach of Iranian-aligned forces. The absence of active Iran-US diplomacy, replaced by Iran-Oman bilateral talks, reduces de-escalation channels.
sections.regional_response: Italy's 10 million euro allocation to the PA signals European efforts to stabilize Palestinian governance amid ceasefire uncertainty. Saudi Arabia absorbs Houthi attacks on Yanbu without immediate public retaliation, likely coordinating with US on Red Sea security. The Peace Council's insistence on sequenced withdrawal and dismantlement reflects international mediation attempts to enforce the Gaza ceasefire framework. Lebanon's heightened air alert and helicopter movements indicate readiness for potential spillover. Syria's unexplained explosion in Hama adds to the opaque security environment. Gulf states remain focused on Hormuz navigation rights and oil price stability as Trump links both to an Iran
